name: Fiber Core Steel Wire Rope
wText: Ø 8 – 64 mm · MBF up to 2711 kN
desc: Round-strand steel wire rope with a fibre core (FC) — the flexible, general-purpose lifting, rigging and haulage rope. The fibre core cushions the six strands and holds lubricant, giving good flexibility and shock absorption for slinging, winching and general pulling. Available across the 6×19F (12-6F+6-1), 6×21F (10-5F-5-1) and 6×29F (14-7F+7-1) classes; an equivalent steel-core (IWRC) version is offered where higher strength or crush resistance is required. Tensile grades 1570 / 1770 / 1960 N/mm², galvanized or bright. Diameters Ø 8–64 mm, minimum breaking force up to 2711 kN. All intermediate sizes available on request and prior confirmation.
